texts.admin.name: Name
texts.fields.the_saved_schedule_that_created_t: The saved schedule that created this run. Open it to review its inputs and timing.
texts.fields.the_saved_history_record_for_one_: The saved history record for one job run, distinct from its kernel execution ID.
texts.fields.the_package_and_job_filename_defi: The package and job filename defining this read-only schedule.
texts.fields.choose_an_enabled_account_to_run_: Choose an enabled account to run this job. Interactive programs use the currently signed-in user instead.
texts.fields.a_name_that_helps_you_recognize_t: A name that helps you recognize this job in schedules and run history.
texts.fields.scheduled_jobs_can_run_at_their_n: Scheduled jobs can run at their next matching time. Paused jobs do not start new scheduled runs.
texts.fields.the_outcome_of_this_run_interrupt: The outcome of this run. Interrupted means its completion is unknown; it is not automatically replayed.
texts.fields.any_runs_once_on_an_available_nod: **Any** runs once on an available node. **All** runs once on each enabled node. Select an exact node when work must run there.
texts.fields.the_next_matching_schedule_time_i: The next matching schedule time in UTC. A dash means there is no upcoming occurrence.
texts.fields.the_utc_occurrence_time_for_this_: The UTC occurrence time for this run. Dispatch may follow on the next scheduler tick.
texts.fields.when_this_run_started_executing_i: When this run started executing in UTC. A dash means it has not started.
texts.fields.when_this_run_completed_in_utc_a: When this run completed in UTC. A dash means completion has not been recorded.
texts.fields.values_passed_to_the_program_in_o: Values passed to the program, in order. Use a JSON array such as `[{"message":"Hello"}]`, or `[]` for no inputs.
texts.fields.allow_this_schedule_to_create_new: Allow this schedule to create new runs. Pausing does not cancel runs already queued or running.
texts.fields.specific_utc_appointments_one_yyy: Specific UTC appointments, one `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM` datetime per line. These can be combined with a recurring pattern.
texts.fields.add_a_recurring_pattern_alongside: Add a recurring pattern alongside any specific UTC appointments.
texts.fields.the_first_utc_date_on_which_the: The first UTC date on which the recurring pattern may run.
texts.fields.include_this_month_in_the_recurri: Include this month in the recurring pattern. Only checked months can produce recurring runs.
texts.fields.run_on_this_weekday_at_each_liste: Run on this weekday at each listed UTC time, within the selected months.
texts.fields.choose_weekdays_such_as_monday_or: Choose weekdays such as Monday, or numbered dates such as the 1st and 15th of each month.
texts.fields.comma_separated_dates_from_1_thro: Comma-separated dates from **1** through **31**. Dates missing from a month are skipped.
texts.fields.separate_24_hour_hh_mm_times_with: Separate 24-hour `HH:MM` times with commas, for example `09:00, 14:30`.
texts.fields.the_kernel_job_execution_associat: The kernel job execution associated with this run, available after execution returns its identity.
texts.fields.the_execution_context_used_to_cor: The execution context used to correlate this run with its logs and child work.
texts.fields.the_reported_reason_this_run_fail: The reported reason this run failed or was interrupted.
texts.fields.the_program_result_as_json_pendin: The program result as JSON. Pending means this run has not yet returned a result.
texts.fields.whether_the_stored_result_is_comp: Whether the stored result is complete or was shortened because it exceeded the capture limit.
texts.admin.logs_for_this_run_are_unavailable: Logs for this run are unavailable.
texts.admin.logs_will_be_available_after_this_: Logs will be available after this run finishes.
texts.admin.no_log_messages_in_this_page: No log messages in this page.
